title: INNER vs LEFT JOIN
description: Why the instructor with no department disappears from an inner join.

input.query:
-- Inner join: only instructors that have a department
SELECT i.name, d.name AS department
FROM instructors AS i
JOIN departments AS d ON d.dept_id = i.dept_id;

-- Left join: every instructor, NULL when there is no match
SELECT i.name, d.name AS department
FROM instructors AS i
LEFT JOIN departments AS d ON d.dept_id = i.dept_id;
